description: Beyond the 2-jet (#4401): higher NZ jets of the 4₁ potential and the exact all-orders Φ on the winding lattice, via the corpus A-polynomial machinery (qbeta_nz_even_series_fourone_probe). (1) No odd jets (v odd, corpus-verified). (2) Higher even jets: τ = −i√3, v₃ = −i√3/3 corpus-recognized; v₃/(2τ) = 1/6 EXACT ⇒ the 4-jet multiplies the 2-jet by (1 + u²/6), Eisenstein-arithmetic on the lattice; v₅, v₇ extracted radius-stably and recognition attempted at small height (tiered, see data). (3) All-orders Φ(u_{m,ℓ}) by tracked-branch ray integration at the canonical windings: the sign pattern agrees with the 2-jet arithmetic sign(G) at every tested winding, with worst all-orders deviation from the 2-jet < 2% at the physical scale ln q₀ — the lattice sign mechanism is NOT a truncation artifact. Signs compared within one branch convention. No c_k, no magnitude claim, nothing wired.
